name: single_qubit_gates
description: Every fixed single-qubit gate in the set, in order.

code.qiskit:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

qc = QuantumCircuit(1)
qc.h(0)
qc.x(0)
qc.y(0)
qc.z(0)
qc.s(0)
qc.sdg(0)
qc.t(0)
qc.tdg(0)
code.cirq:
import cirq

q = cirq.LineQubit.range(1)
# Cirq lists q[0] first in a state; Qiskit lists qubit 0 last. The circuit is the same.
circuit = cirq.Circuit(
    cirq.H(q[0]),
    cirq.X(q[0]),
    cirq.Y(q[0]),
    cirq.Z(q[0]),
    cirq.S(q[0]),
    (cirq.S**-1)(q[0]),
    cirq.T(q[0]),
    (cirq.T**-1)(q[0]),
)
code.pennylane:
import pennylane as qml

dev = qml.device("default.qubit", wires=1)


@qml.qnode(dev)
def circuit():
    qml.Hadamard(wires=0)
    qml.PauliX(wires=0)
    qml.PauliY(wires=0)
    qml.PauliZ(wires=0)
    qml.S(wires=0)
    qml.adjoint(qml.S)(wires=0)
    qml.T(wires=0)
    qml.adjoint(qml.T)(wires=0)
    # PennyLane lists wire 0 first in a state; Qiskit lists qubit 0 last. The circuit is the same.
    return qml.state()
